correctness.rationale: PASS: Determinant polarization det(S-A)=det S+det A-tr(adj(S)A) gives an exact trace-linear condition on A in SL2(R_k). Smooth SL2 reduction contributes p^{3j} lifts if all S entries share p^j. Primitive singular det δ≡0 mod p is SL-equivalent to diag(1,δ), with factorization bc unit and count p^{2k+j-1}(p-1). For primitive unit det, substituting B=S0^-1 A yields det(B)=δ^-1, trace p^j; b c=a(t-a)-d, and valuation factorization plus square completion gives H_m(t,d)=phi(p^m) sum_{h<m}p^{m-h} rho_h(t²-4d)+p^m rho_m(t²-4d). Hensel root count rho_h includes even-valued discriminant p^{2s}u with 2p^s roots or zero, and zero discriminant p^floor(h/2). The j>=1 unit discriminant and j=0 arbitrary discriminate branches yield displayed exhaustive formula. Its minimum and multiplicity follow from rank-one mod-p targets and nonsquare unit discriminants; normalized ratio p³/((p-1)(p+1)^2). Independent direct sum enumeration verified every S for p=3,k=2 (6561 targets) and p=5,k=1 (625) including sharp minima/multiplicities; finite checks do not replace all-depth Hensel proof.
